adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the job does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no explicit timeout/size limits or conditional request headers, so it will fetch the full feed each run and parsing will necessarily consume the full response content. Also, `feed_key` is defined but never referenced anywhere in the diff, so there is no implemented caching/If-Modified-Since/ETag behavior; the hourly job will re-download and iterate items every time (though `TopicEmbed.import` prevents duplicate topic creation via DB lookup/sha1). This is a concrete robustness/performance concern rather than a correctness bug proven by the diff.
